description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的持有人结构数据。可按基金代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、个人持有份额及占比、机构持有份额及占比、金融机构持有份额及占比等数据。当用户想了解某公募基金的持有人结构（个人vs机构比例），判断基金是被散户还是机构持有时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain fund holder structure data for A-share funds. Filters can be applied by fund code and date range, returning fields such as date, individual holding shares and ratio, institutional holding shares and ratio, and financial institution holding shares and ratio. Call this interface when users want to understand the holder structure of a fund (individual vs. institutional ratio) or assess whether a fund is held by retail investors or institutions.
